product_one_liner.value: Aikido provides a unified, AI-powered application-security platform that finds and helps fix vulnerabilities across code, cloud, and runtime for software development and security teams.
product_one_liner.notes: Homepage describes securing what developers build, ship, and run and delivering fixes.

named_customers.notes: Both are identified as customers in published customer stories.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn company listing specifies 201–500; Revelio Labs estimates 355 employees in June 2026.

hq_location.notes: Company's European headquarters is in Ghent, Belgium.

founded_year.notes: Company and company-profile sources identify 2022 as its founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The blog includes multiple technical posts on agent architecture/security, model benchmarking and on-prem product implementation.

public_docs.notes: Public help center and API documentation portal are available.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live job board includes an AI Engineer posting.

model_provider.value: Aikido publicly describes its own open-weight Aikido Altar model, but does not disclose a third-party model provider for its product AI.
model_provider.notes: The docs page describes Aikido's AI functionality without naming an outside provider; the company blog identifies its own open-weight Aikido Altar model.

compliance_certs.notes: Trust Center cites SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001:2022. Other labels on the broader trust center are not included because this field is limited to the specified certificates.

last_funding.notes: Company announcement says it raised $60 million in a Series B on January 14, 2026.

raised_18mo.notes: The January 2026 Series B falls within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Current postings include Business Development Representative and Account Executive positions.

launched_6mo.notes: The company announced launching Noon on October 20, 2026, inside the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The accessible leadership page lists the leadership team but provides no evidence of a C-level or VP-level appointment or departure in the specified window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Reviewed customer story, careers page, and product help resources; no CRM or sales/marketing system use was named in these accessible sources. Customer tools such as Jira and Slack are not CRM systems.
